level: rate-level (population firing-rate Delta_exposure) + run-mean H and Theta phenotypes

contrast_definitions.beta_RF: (B-A+D-C)/2  [RF main: RFon minus RFoff, averaged over Rate]
contrast_definitions.beta_tau: (C-A+D-B)/2  [Rate main: RateSlow minus RateRef, averaged over RF]
contrast_definitions.beta_RFxTau: (D-C)-(B-A)  [interaction: rate effect at RFon minus rate effect at RFoff]

inputs.hash_verify_note: all eight files verified sha256_16 against each cell's artifact_hashes.json; matches_sealed=true

H_run_mean.definition: run-mean H = h_extrema.mean over the full run (executor-computed in result.json)
H_run_mean.interpretation: RF-on raises the run-mean H operating point (+0.0209); LONG/slow rate lowers it (-0.0273); interaction -0.0245 is comparable in size to the mains and negative, i.e. the RF boost is much weaker at the slow rate (B-A=+0.0331 vs D-C=+0.0086) and the slow-rate drop is stronger with RF on. Descriptive magnitudes at n=1/cell; no inferential SE.

Theta_run_mean.definition: run-mean Theta = w_extrema.mean over the full run (executor-computed in result.json)
Theta_run_mean.evidence_status: OBSERVED (all four cells; recorded run means)
Theta_run_mean.interpretation: Theta/w is numerically near-static in every cell (all contrasts <= 1.2e-4 absolute, <4% of the recorded w value). Contrast signs are not mechanistically meaningful at this scale and the entire Theta trajectory of all four cells sits BELOW w_floor=0.01 (design bounds [0.01,10]) - flagged UNRESOLVED for physical interpretation, not adjudicated here. The recorded run-mean values themselves are OBSERVED.

Delta_exposure_rate_level.definition: Y_post - Y_pre with Y = whole-trial [-500,4124] ms mean population rate per area (jomission_comparison_matrix.v0.1.0 proxy). PRIMARY design estimand is the slot-resolved [0,531] ms rate omission effect, which is NOT RECOVERABLE from any cell's retained artifacts.
Delta_exposure_rate_level.evidence_status: UNRESOLVED for the factorial (cells B and D NOT_RECORDED at the rate level; cell A single-replicate partial proxy). Betas NOT computed - never imputed.

A_RFoff_RateRef.note: covers 3/12 conditions (AAAB intact, AXAB p2, BBBA intact); slot-resolved estimand NOT RECOVERABLE

B_RFon_RateRef.reason: whole_trial_rate_per_area NOT_RECORDED in E_B_analysis (pre-fix run lost post per-area rates); E_B_analysis predates the save-fix deterministic rerun whose result.json supplies the run means

C_RFoff_RateSlow.n: 8 paired replicates per condition (pre and post)
C_RFoff_RateSlow.note: whole-trial proxy; slot-resolved estimand NOT RECOVERABLE; PRE-phase startup relaxation confounds early-battery conditions (drop-first-replicate sensitivity in E_C_analysis)

D_RFon_RateSlow.reason: E_D_analysis is SMOKE_VALID only (no Delta_exposure section); deterministic rerun result.json carries run means only

Delta_exposure_rate_level.interpretation: No rate-level Delta_exposure claim is made across the factorial: B and D lack observed rate Delta_exposure and A is a single-replicate 3-condition proxy. Missing execution/data is UNRESOLVED, never NEGATIVE, per frozen discipline.

uncertainty_note: n=1 run per cell; every estimate is a single-run magnitude with no within-cell SE; descriptive only, no inferential test (design 2-way ANOVA requires n>=4 per cell). Contrasts are balanced-cell arithmetic means of cell means.
consistency_flags: Theta (w) run means sit below w_floor=0.01 in all four cells (design bounds [0.01,10]); physical interpretation UNRESOLVED (clamping-vs-recorded-mean not adjudicated)
